source_brief.standout: Segmented limbs and clearly held gestures make a luminous character feel hand-animated.
source_brief.scene: An intimate sculptural nighttime LED puppet theater. A large original friendly geometric marionette made of cyan circles at joints, warm-gold limb contour segments, violet torso, with decorative light strings hanging from a grounded truss. One puppet pose bright and alternate static limb outlines dark. Four bottom storyboard cells show arm lowered, elbow bent, arm extended in greeting, held wave pose. Finite supported contour frames, no actual servo or cable movement promised.
